research_rationale: This partial candidate begins with the assigned claim draft and replaces its malformed ten-clause segmentation with twenty exact held-text spans covering sections 1 through 7. Full official-source extracts for EO 11256 (30 FR 14137-14138) and EO 12379 (47 FR 36099-36100) were read, and their recorded PDF hashes match GPO fixity rows. EO 12379 section 18 states that EO 11256 is revoked; its immediate present-tense command, dated August 17, 1982, has no deferred-effective clause elsewhere in the full actor, supporting that date as a later formal revocation event only. The preamble expressly concerns inactive or unnecessary committees. EO 11256 section 6 instead makes the actual final-report submission plus ninety days an earlier cessation candidate, not the report deadline in section 4(c). No first-end or whole-order date is assigned. Section 7 and accrued compensation/support remain separately unresolved. Provisional NO is preserved; absent page images and incomplete occurrence/cutoff evidence prevent complete lifecycle acceptance.
unresolved_material_gaps: Official PDF page images for EO 11256 and EO 12379 were not available at the cited cache paths and were not inspected. Held complete text extracts and matching GPO fixity rows support a limited partial candidate, not page-verified text.

EO 11256 section 6 ends the Committee and Commission ninety days after submission of the Commission final report. The actual submission date and any earlier relevant cessation have not been established; section 4(c) is a deadline only. First ends and whole_order_end remain null.

EO 11256 section 7 immediately revokes EO 10472 and EO 10937. Its executed effect and any surviving or independently grounded effects require separate lifecycle treatment; no first-end date is inferred from execution or the 1982 cleanup.

Accrued compensation/travel reimbursement under section 3(d), reimbursable administrative support under section 5(c), and effects of section 7 remain unclosed; no blanket savings conclusion is asserted.
Bounded corpus searches do not establish final-report occurrence or full statutory coverage through 2026-10-14: the held U.S. Code search stops at 2026-10-09. later_source_search remains empty.

Claim-kit cross-actor chain entries attach EO 12379 section 18 to ten different named orders and their dates. These are rejected from the exact held actor text; they provide no earlier-ending evidence. Earlier amendments were not found in target EDGES rows, but absence there is not exhaustive.
